title: Groove Root Opening
goal: A practitioner can read the groove root opening artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: A visible AWS reference line, arrow, and weld symbol identify the joint.
The symbol placement visibly distinguishes the specified weld side or both sides.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Independent redraw using the AWS exemplar visual system and AWS official A2.4 symbol chart. Source dimensions and processes preserved; joint sketch is schematic, not fabrication geometry. Rendered and visually inspected against source and AWS exemplar: weld side, dimensions, supplementary marks, contour/finish separation, leader attachment and typography checked.
